package shop

import (
	"bytes"
	"os"
	"testing"
)

func TestHiddenNewFile(t *testing.T) {
	if _, err := os.Stat("export.go"); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var out bytes.Buffer
	items := []Item{{SKU: "a", Price: 250, Qty: 2}, {SKU: "b", Price: 5, Qty: 3}}
	if err := ExportCSV(&out, items); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	want := "sku,qty,price,line_total\na,2,2.50,5.00\nb,3,0.05,0.15\n"
	if out.String() != want {
		t.Fatalf("got %q", out.String())
	}
	out.Reset()
	if err := ExportCSV(&out, nil); err != nil || out.String() != "sku,qty,price,line_total\n" {
		t.Fatalf("empty: %q, %v", out.String(), err)
	}
}
